properties.description: One incident per source IP and severity, from the alerts of the detection rules (which raise no incidents themselves). Generated by tools/build.py.
properties.query:
// The detection rules' alerts ingested since the last run (see tools/build.py)
let rules = dynamic(["f43d56d0-fad2-4a84-a60f-bcdae35dec14", "9feb96f8-f354-42ad-9667-a5569b03a61d", "5577b658-fa17-4a11-96ed-dd7251823f3f", "8dd7290a-644a-4db3-8cff-0096442c04de", "73bebb72-8d49-45e8-a00d-e6cf48c45581", "9be2e151-09ea-4bb9-a8da-686525c6de97", "e7422729-a8c4-4a2e-a231-6308e91246af", "fc6fa16e-8ed1-44c3-b72a-2956acce4304", "e0fd1b5d-fea0-406c-8f3e-2a527feea7b0", "6f1334fc-a6bb-42b6-81f2-0f8ec35050d4", "0c3ca02b-4c90-445d-9622-1067e937e361", "06013da3-dde3-410c-a7d7-4cd15e859f6b", "c3d1c2e7-602e-4cb4-a4c8-52a99b66c1e5", "7e15ebb1-6111-4e6c-851b-4f6d36099f0b", "9a1edbdd-3518-4170-a9f7-7d476a9221d1", "22c98147-e208-4d3b-93cf-d906bbdd5945", "92b9d317-840c-40f1-b833-19392ae8a98d"]);
SecurityAlert
| where ingestion_time() > ago(5m) and ingestion_time() <= now()
| where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts" and tostring(split(AlertType, "_")[1]) in (rules)
| mv-expand e = todynamic(Entities) | where tostring(e.Type) == "ip"
| extend src_ip = tostring(e.Address), Rule = tostring(split(AlertName, " from ")[0]),
    Sev = case(AlertSeverity == "High", 3, AlertSeverity == "Medium", 2, AlertSeverity == "Low", 1, 0)
| mv-expand Tactic = split(Tactics, ",") to typeof(string)
| mv-expand Technique = iff(isempty(Techniques), dynamic([""]), todynamic(Techniques)) to typeof(string)
| summarize Sev = max(Sev), Rules = make_set(Rule), TacticSet = make_set_if(trim(" ", Tactic), trim(" ", Tactic) !in ("", "Unknown")),
    TechniqueSet = make_set_if(Technique, isnotempty(Technique)), Alerts = dcount(SystemAlertId),
    FirstSeen = min(StartTime), LastSeen = max(EndTime) by src_ip
| extend Severity = case(Sev == 3, "High", Sev == 2, "Medium", Sev == 1, "Low", "Informational"),
    RuleList = strcat_array(array_sort_asc(Rules), ", "), TacticList = strcat_array(TacticSet, ","),
    Techniques = tostring(TechniqueSet)
| project src_ip, Severity, RuleList, TacticList, Techniques, Alerts, FirstSeen, LastSeen
